latestAnswer().details: Important to highlight that this is not prone to manipulation, because sAVAX manages its exchange rate in a "static" way, without dynamically checking for AVAX staked in the contract. - If the price AVAX/USD would be 0, this will also return 0 (this should never happen) - We also assume that the exchange rate of 1 sAVAX can't be more than the limit of uint256 -> int256 cast   given the close correlation between AVAX and sAVAX

returns._0: int256 The price, in AaveOracle compatible units

latestAnswer().notice: Returns the price of sAVAX, from the AVAX/USD * AVAX/sAVAX exchange rate
